analyst_view.overall: Early view: Famalicão are 10th under interim coach Ricardo Silva, who has had mixed results: a 4-0 win at Rio Ave, a 3-0 defeat at Braga with ten men, and a late 1-0 win over Arouca. They play Benfica away six days earlier. Académico Viseu are 6th under Bruno Pinheiro and won six in a row before losing 1-0 at Nacional. The coach situation at Famalicão could change before kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. I lean slightly higher: Famalicão's games average about 2.6 goals and Académico's about 2.5, and Famalicão showed at Rio Ave that they can score in bunches. Académico have conceded 13, so they are not watertight.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, mostly Famalicão. That fits a home side with more possession against an Académico team that wins through efficiency. I keep to the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, already high. Famalicão have had three players sent off in recent games and Académico's home game with Rio Ave ended in a brawl, but 5.3 already allows for a feisty game. I stay with the site's figure.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots, with 17.7 for Famalicão. That looks generous for a team that needed a 90th-minute goal to beat Arouca. I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Académico's defence has held up well during their winning run, and Famalicão's attack has been inconsistent. I lean slightly lower.
